description: Strict composition of total numerical functions agrees with their ordinary total composition.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.strictComp_total {m n : ℕ}
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args m → ℕ)
  (g : Fin m → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args n → ℕ) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.strictComp
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.lift h) fun i =>
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.lift (g i)) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.lift fun x => h (List.Vector.ofFn fun i => g i x)
